description: Agent control: agent.report keeps draft and pid in props.agent (a report without them forgets them), agent.report_session keeps model and thinking (a report without them keeps the last), agent.list says open, focused, draft, model and thinking, and agent.restart's checks: target, mode, args, then its refusals in order (blocked, working, a draft), and resume without a recorded session. Never a restart that goes through: the app really relaunches the session.
recordedOn: easl agent/control (rebased on bd72485), dev instance
